Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bataan(Limay, Orion, Pilar, Balanga, Abucay), Zambales(Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz), Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, San Manuel, Moncada, San Clemente, Camiling, Anao, Ramos, Paniqui, Pura, Gerona), Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Guagua, Santa Rita, Bacolor, Lubao, Macabebe, Masantol, Sasmuan), Nueva Ecija(Nampicuan, Cuyapo, Guimba, Carranglan, Pantabangan, Lupao, Talugtug), Quezon(Mauban, Sampaloc, Lucban), Rizal(Binangonan, Angono), Laguna(Los Banos, Calamba), Batangas(Balete, Santo Tomas, Tanauan, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Talisay, Laurel, Nasugbu, Tuy, Calaca) and Cavite(Tagaytay, Amadeo, General Trias, Silang) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
